steady_state: sigma_gb -> 0 everywhere (traction-free grain boundary); deposited wedge holds it open as a classical edge crack of length h under remote tension sigma0; K = 1.1215 sigma0 sqrt(pi h).
method: Eigen-analysis of A f = PV int S(x,xi) f'''(xi) dxi, BCs f(0)=0, f'(1)=f''(1)=0. Primary: spectral collocation in s=sqrt(1-x), basis phi_k=s^k-1, exact kernel moments, truncated-SVD projection + QZ for the numerically singular pencil. Cross-checks: two finite-difference panel discretizations (Richardson limits bracket the spectral lambda1), off-grid continuous-equation residuals, implicit-Euler time evolution (decay-rate fit, sigma->0). K: crack integral equation solved by moment collocation in the (1-xi)^m basis; extracted from tip coefficient and outside stress; both give 1.12152, matching the classical edge crack 1.1215.
